data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): JiraAPIError has NO .message attribute — applier.py:49-54 only sets self.status_code; message goes through Exception.__init__ and is reachable via str(exc) or exc.args[0]. Spec the heuristic substring match against str(exc) (or 'exc.args[0] if exc.args else ""'). Add a RED test that constructs JiraAPIError('illegal transition from Open to Done', 400) and asserts the heuristic matches via str(exc). Do NOT use getattr(exc, 'message', '') — returns empty string and silently breaks the heuristic.
